definitions.explanation: The people who make up a group, team, committee, or event. Focuses on the identity and quality of the individuals involved.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{顔|かお}ぶれは{豪華|ごうか}だ。
examples.english: The lineup this time is impressive.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}の{顔|かお}ぶれが{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The members of the committee were announced.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{同|おな}じ{顔|かお}ぶれが{集|あつ}まるので、そろそろ{新|あたら}しいメンバーがほしい。
examples.english: The same faces gather every year, so I'd like some new members soon.

notes:
Literally "face lineup" — {顔|かお} (face) + ぶれ (from {触|ふ}れ, announcement/display). Focuses on who the people are rather than how many there are.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪華|ごうか}な{顔|かお}ぶれ (an impressive/star-studded lineup)
- {同|おな}じ{顔|かお}ぶれ (the same faces/people)
- {顔|かお}ぶれが{揃|そろ}う (the members are all assembled)
- {顔|かお}ぶれが{変|か}わる (the lineup changes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- メンバー is a neutral term for members
- {顔|かお}ぶれ emphasizes the identities and often implies a notable or scrutinized group
